# AiProtocol

> AiProtocol (aiprotocol.kz) is a B2B product for offline businesses in Kazakhstan: a magnetic audio badge worn by frontline staff plus AI analysis of their conversations with customers. The business owner gets a report on each conversation.

## What it is
- Hardware: a flat black magnetic audio badge worn on the chest. One button on top. No camera, no display. Shows the employee role and a "conversation is being recorded" notice.
- Software: recorded conversations are transcribed and analysed by AI for script compliance, politeness, upsells/cross-sells and mistakes.
- Output: reports for the owner or head of the chain.

## Who it is for
- B2B only: owners and managers of offline points of sale in Kazakhstan.
- Industries: pharmacies, clinics and medical centres, retail, car dealerships and auto service, restaurants, gas stations.
- Difference from call analytics tools: AiProtocol analyses face-to-face conversations in physical locations, not phone calls or messenger chats.

## Offer
- Free pilot: 1 badge for 3 days, free of charge.
- Request a pilot via WhatsApp +7 777 555 67 89 (https://wa.me/77775556789) or the form on the website.
- Pricing is calculated individually (depends on number of employees and locations).
